## Shapes work on slides

The same `.shape-*` divs you use in HTML documents render in RevealJS presentations.

::: {.shape-circle fill="#42526C" .shape-lg .shape-center}
Hello
:::

## Hold content

Callout shapes are designed to wrap text, so they double as decorative containers on a slide.

::: {.shape-speech-bubble fill="#4DADAD" .shape-lg .shape-center}
Good point!
:::

## Mix modifiers

Fill, stroke, size, and rotation are all composable.

:::: {layout-ncol=3}
::: {.shape-hexagon fill="none" stroke="#E24A68" .shape-stroke-lg .shape-md}
:::

::: {.shape-star fill="#FCC93F" .shape-md}
:::

::: {.shape-arrow fill="#42526C" .shape-rotate-90 .shape-md}
:::
::::

## Decorate a list

::: {.shape-shield fill="#42526C" .shape-md .shape-center}
:::

- Built from inline SVG
- No image files to manage
- Styled entirely with attributes and classes
